purpose: Research-only adjudications for conflicts between the CBF basic schedule PDF score column and the individual official CBF match record.

adjudications.reason: The individual official CBF match page identifies match 245, Round 25, 31 August 2026, and records 1-1. The CBF Round 25 article also records Fortaleza 1 x 1 Operário-PR. The 23 September basic schedule PDF score column conflicts at 1-0. The individual match record is used as the controlling result; raw provider and PDF evidence remain unchanged.
